note: [LLM critic, medium conf] The AI kept Mek Beta on a home objective that already has 17 OC and no enemy threat. The Mek cannot reach any other objective this turn, so the hold wastes its turn. Fix: Score stay_on_objective by marginal OC. If the units already on the objective exceed the enemy OC in range by a wide margin and no enemy can reach it next turn, set the stay bonus to zero. Then free the surplus unit to move. Also cap contest_race penalties for units that would arrive alone.
